verbatim_quote.english_translation: O1 single mode-parameterized prompt per Manager-selected brainstorm

extracted_decision.summary: Selected O1: one mode-parameterized prompt instead of two generated prompt variants (manual and automatic).
extracted_decision.rationale: O1 was ranked first because it keeps one source of truth, lowers fragment-drift risk, simplifies build and global-install behavior, and protects manual-flow safety with MODE conditionals and per-mode tests.
alternatives: O2: two generated prompt variants, one manual file and one automatic file
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: O1 reduces drift and install complexity but risks manual-wording leakage if MODE conditionals are weak; O2 isolates manual text but doubles maintenance, QA, and review effort
